m.t: Opening closed chests
m.pg: Money making guide/Opening closed chests
m.h:
The closed chest, located in the Yanille Agility dungeon, always rewards nine herbs when opened: three grimy ranarr, two grimy harralander, and one each of grimy torstol, grimy irit, grimy avantoe and grimy kwuarm. Opening the chest requires a sinister key, and the key is used up when the chest is opened. Depending on the price difference between the keys and the herbs, it can be very profitable to buy sinister keys, open the chest, and sell the resulting herbs.

Start out by summoning your best Beast of Burden; a war tortoise or pack yak is recommended. Wear a slashing weapon of any kind, and withdraw two law runes, along with 5 sinister keys (war tortoise) or 6 sinister keys (pack yak). Teleport to the Watchtower, go down the ladder, and run east to the dungeon entrance. Slash the web, go down the stairs, and across the agility ledge. Enter the obstacle pipe immediately next to you and open the chest at the end of the room. You will be poisoned, but this only hits for about 15 damage and can safely be ignored. Keep opening the chest (it takes about 8 seconds each), storing the herbs in your Beast of Burden as needed. Depending on the price of the grimy harralander, it may be worthwhile to drop them so you can use more keys per load. When you've used all of your keys, bank the herbs (War's Retreat Teleport is ideal) and repeat. When using the war tortoise pouch, you can open about 135 chests per hour. When using a pack yak, you can open about 150. Sell your herbs on the Grand Exchange when finished.

m.t: Opening muddy chests (Pack yak)
m.pg: Money making guide/Opening muddy chests

rq.h: or Obelisk shards or Portable obelisk

rq.nt: completed to choose the destination of obelisk teleports

m.h:
Located in the centre of the Lava Maze, the muddy chest contains various rewards. Opening it consumes a muddy key. Muddy keys have a buying limit of 100 on the Grand Exchange, but they are relatively easy to buy since they have a high trade volume.

Starting your run, fill your inventory and pack yak with muddy keys. Teleport to the level 44 obelisk using an obelisk shard or the portable obelisk. Make your way through the maze, slashing the webs apart and avoiding the hellhounds. Having a kitchen built in Fort Forinthry gives a 100% success rate in slashing spider webs. Reach the muddy chest at the end. Avoid the aggressive ripper demons inside the muddy chest area or turn on Protect from Melee/Deflect Melee. When finished, teleport out of the maze. Bank, heal if necessary, and refill your yak and inventory with keys using a preset. Rinse and repeat.

Be wary as your first used key can drop items on the floor. Dive and Mobile can be used to optimise your running time. Out of the three ripper demons at the end of the maze, only the westernmost one is in aggro range of the chest. The best way to deal with it is to lure it north, outside of the fence, then east and directly south, on top of the earth staff spawn. Then teleport out so it doesn't follow you. It should stay there indefinitely, provided no one comes close to it.

m.t: Opening muddy chests in free-to-play worlds
m.pg: Money making guide/Opening muddy chests
m.h:
Located in the centre of the Lava Maze, the muddy chest contains various rewards. Opening it consumes a muddy key. Muddy keys have a buying limit of 100 on the Grand Exchange, but they are relatively easy to buy since they have a high trade volume.

Make your way to the Lava Maze with 28 muddy keys in your inventory either by running, using teleports, or using the canoe. Slash the webs apart and avoid the hellhounds (or turn on Protect from Melee), and make your way to the muddy chest at the end. Run to the nearest cape seller/banker to the west of the Lava Maze and refill your inventory with keys using a preset. Sometimes a roaming banker will be within sight when you leave the maze so use this bank when possible.

Free players will either get 5000 or 15000 coins from the chest, with an estimated average of 7500 per opening. This means only one inventory space is required for all the loot. Use Surge to optimise your running time.

Make sure you're actually using the high capacity plank maker, instead of the regular plank maker. If you do not, the profit gained from this activity will be lower than shown on this page.

You will first need to have built a plank maker, then create the high capacity plank maker. You can build a high capacity plank maker in the Invention Guild with 117 Invention. If provided with machine charges, this machine will convert logs into planks. The machine requires about 341,913.6 gp worth of divine charges to run for a day, and will convert 960 logs to planks every single day. It can hold up to 7,500 items at once, and thus can be left to run for about a week without any required input.

With a jumbo generator, up to two high capacity plank makers can be run at a time, potentially resulting in doubled profit, at the expense of being limited in terms of what other machines can be used. Additionally, with a fully upgraded Workshop in Fort Forinthry, three can be used, but there will be no power left for any other machines. To allow profit to be easily calculated for any combination of machines, this page calculates profit on a per-machine basis.

Its not recommended to use logs or planks with low volume, as these can be a slow buy and sell.

Increasing profitability

With the introduction of a new Construction training method of reconstructing various building within Fort Forinthry, processing planks into refined planks and frames in the Workshop may provide an increased profit. For example, compare the price of 12 magic logs, 10,968 gp (12 yew logs: 7,260 gp), with 1 magic frame, 44,797 gp (1 yew frame: 45,744 gp). Profitability may be added to or subtracted from depending on how materials are sourced e.g. manually woodcutting logs or purchasing refined planks.

It takes 4 planks to create 1 refined plank, and 3 refined planks to construct 1 frame. 480 frames can be constructed in 1 hour, requiring 1,440 refined planks, which would take 3 hours to create from 5,760 planks. The handiness of the plank maker removes the need for the player to turn logs into planks themselves, which would save the player a little over 4 hours (assuming a rate of 1,400 logs manually processed into planks per hour).

m.t: Using the partial potion producer DX to make unfinished potions
m.pg: Money making guide/Operating partial potion producer DX

rq.h: Built a partial potion producer DX and fill it with charges

m.h:
Make sure you're actually using the partial potion producer DX, instead of the regular potion producer. If you do not, the profit gained from this activity will be lower than shown on this page. For more detailed information on which herb to select, see the §Potion prices section below.

Unfinished potions are always in high demand because of their use in the Herblore skill.

You will first need to have built a partial potion producer, then create the partial potion producer DX. You can build a partial potion producer DX in the Invention Guild with 114 Invention. If provided with machine charge, this machine will turn clean herbs and vials of water into their respective unfinished potion. The machine requires about 71232*960/3000 * 210 / 40 round -3 gp worth of divine charge to run for a day, and will convert 960 potions every single day. It can hold up to 13,000 items at once, and can be left to run just short of two weeks without any required input.

With a jumbo generator, up to three partial potion producers DX can be run at a time, potentially resulting in tripled profit, at the expense of not being able to run any other type of machine. To allow profit to be easily calculated for any combination of machines, this page calculates profit on a per-machine basis.

Comparison between other machines

The input capacity and processing time for each type of invention machine (alchemiser, potion producer, disassembler etc) varies. See below for examples:

  • Alchemiser mk. II: 5,000 input for 8 days, 8 hours
  • Partial potion producer DX: 13,000 input for 13 days, 13 hours
  • Auto disassembler mk. II: 13,000 input for 9 days, 1 hour (assuming 1 input = 1 batch)

As such, to compare the profitability of different invention machines a comparison must be made over a unit time period (e.g. weekly, daily etc). The profit per instance and effective profit values given above are specific to the machines processing duration, not a unit time period and therefore are not comparable with other machine types.

m.t: Operating the Alchemiser mk. II
m.pg: Money making guide/Operating the Alchemiser mk. II

rq.h: Alchemiser mk. II

m.h:
Make sure you're actually using the alchemiser mk. II, instead of the regular alchemiser. If you do not, the profit gained from this activity will be lower than shown on this page as that machine also requires fire runes and processes fewer items every day. For more detailed information on which item to select, see the Item prices section below.

You will first need to have built a regular alchemiser, then create the alchemiser mk. II. You can build a alchemiser mk. II in the Invention Guild with 108 Invention. If provided with machine charge, this machine will cast the High level Alchemy spell on the provided items. The machine will alchemise 600 items daily. It can hold up to 5,000 items at once, and thus can be left to run just over 8 days without any required input.

It is possible to boost your Invention level with an extreme invention potion by 17 levels, allowing you to build the alchemiser Mk. II and a jumbo generator at level 91 Invention. Once you have boosted, you must go to the inventor's workbench and research the blueprint.

The buy limit for dragon items is either 10 every four hours (60 per day) or 100 every four hours (600 per day), depending on the item. As the alchemiser mk. II alchemises 600 items per day and you can run 2 at a time. You may need to purchase items directly from other players, buy them while doing other activities, use different item types, or use alternate accounts to bypass the GE buy limits and maximise profits.

Alchable products coming from the common drop table of Zamorakian Undercity such as ascendri bolts (e) and large blunt rune salvage are currently great options for the alchemiser machine. Such items have very high buy limits. Items such as certain dragon items may give greater profit, but a player cannot buy enough to match the rate of the machine.

With a jumbo generator, up to two alchemisers mk. II can be run at a time, potentially resulting in doubled profit, at the expense of being limited in terms of what other machines can be used. To allow profit to be easily calculated for any combination of machines, this page calculates profit on a per-machine basis.
m.post:
Alchemiser mk. II profit

The Alchemiser mk. II is significantly cheaper to run than the Alchemiser, as the basic Alchemiser additionally requires fire runes (and is of a similar machine charge cost). In total, the mk. II saves 71232/3000 * (45 / 8 - 150 / 25) + 195 round 1 gp per item.

Maximum daily profit is calculated by multiplying profit with the buying limit, capped at 100 (25 processed items per hour for 4 hours), and multiplying the result by 6 (assuming the GE limit is reached every 4 hours). At the rate of 600 items a day, an item would require a buy limit of at least 100 in order to be used at the same rate as being bought. ROI (return on investment) is calculated by dividing profit by the cost.

Items with a value of at least 500,000 cannot be placed into an alchemiser mk. II and are not listed.

m.t: Performing powerful essence rituals
m.pg: Money making guide/Performing Powerful essence rituals
m.h:
At level 95 Necromancy, players can perform Powerful essence rituals to create Impure essence, an important ingredient used in Runecrafting Necrotic runes for Necromancy combat.

The ritual lasts for 166 ticks, which means that if disturbances are ignored a ritual can be completed every 99.6 seconds. This allows a player to complete a maximum of 36 rituals per hour.

The lowest common multiple for the glyphs of the ritual is 36. This is the number of rituals at which all glyphs will be fully used without leaving any on the ritual floor, assuming that ritual components are only repaired when they reach 0 durability. For maximizing the use of each glyph drawn, it is recommended to complete rituals in batches of the glyph lowest common multiple number (36 is this case).

The maximum number of essence per ritual is 1164, which requires the following:

  • Place 3 Multiply III glyphs on the ritual site (Necromancy required but can be boosted)
  • Wear an Alteration necklace
  • Wear a Necromancy cape attuned to Multiply III (Necromancy required)

m.t: Performing manifest ectoplasm rituals
m.pg: Money making guide/Performing manifest ectoplasm rituals
m.h:
At level 95 Necromancy, players can perform Manifest ectoplasm rituals to create ectoplasm, an important ingredient used in Necromancy combat. The limiting factor of this money making method is gathering buckets of slime, which are untradable. The fastest way to gather buckets of slime is to bring a stack of Magic notepaper to the pool below the Ectofuntus, where you can gather 580 buckets in the first 8 minutes of your hour. It's recommended to gather much more than 580 buckets per trip to save time banking. It is currently not possible to use the notepaper on the buckets, but you can use the bucket on the notepaper to convert the buckets into bank notes.

A cheaper way to gather buckets of slime (without Magic notepaper) is to use Morytania legs 2, Morytania legs 3, or Morytania legs 4 which grant 5, 10, or unlimited free daily teleports to the Ectofuntus slime pool, respectively. If using a Pack yak and Morytania legs 4, it is possible to gather 1160 buckets of slime in about 33 minutes. This method saves 1160*529 gp for about 2 hours worth of rituals, but can only be performed once per day.

The maximum number of ectoplasms per ritual is 213, which requires the following:

  • Place 3 Multiply III glyphs on the ritual site (Necromancy required but can be boosted)
  • Wear an Alteration necklace
  • Wear a Necromancy cape attuned to Multiply III (Necromancy required)

The buckets of slime can be converted in 29 rituals using the remainder of the hour, yielding 6,177 ectoplasm per hour.

m.t: Searching a Divine herb patch III
m.pg: Money making guide/Picking a divine herb patch III
m.h:
Note: This guide's estimates are based on solo searches or participants. Profit may be greatly increased for the placer of the patch if there are a number of other players searching their patch. If you are a participant, i.e. someone else placed the patch, there is no divination requirement for creating nor are there any materials to input.

Once daily, a player may create one divine location of any kind. In addition to this, the player has a limit on how much they may harvest from any divine location. This limit is nearly reached from a single divine herb patch III. The time for creating and harvesting from divine locations resets every day at 00:00 UTC.

If you are placing a patch of your own, it is best to find a spot with others who would search it with you as each other participant on a divine location gives the placer extra loot at random intervals. The profit can be up to doubled for placing your own patch. The chance of receiving a noted herb is 40% every 1.2 seconds per person. On average, you can expect 8 herbs per other participant, working for up to 5 people. Note however, you will likely reach your limit before you can get 8 herbs from every participant. m.t: Picking bananas
m.pg: Money making guide/Picking bananas
m.h:
Bananas can be picked in the banana plantation on Musa Point. By far the simplest way to get there is with an amulet of glory, which places you steps from the banana trees. Using baskets, which hold five bananas each, can significantly increase the number picked per hour. Bank using either the amulet of glory itself (Al Kharid option teleports you to Shantay Pass 3 steps away from a bank chest) or TokKul-Zo (which also is very close to a bank and has unlimited teleports) if available.

Start out with 23 baskets in your inventory, with amulet of glory and TokKul-Zo (optional) equipped. Put one of the empty baskets on your action bar so that whenever you click it, it will fill the first empty basket you have (note that this will only fill empty baskets, so be careful not to only partially fill any basket). Start picking bananas from the trees - conveniently, each one has exactly five bananas, which is the number needed to fill a basket. After picking each tree clean, click to fill your basket, and move on to the next one. If you pick all the trees, hop to another world to continue. When all 23 baskets are full, bank, and repeat. Each trip takes about 2.5 minutes, so you can bank up to 552 bananas (5) (plus 120 additional bananas that you couldn't basket) per hour. These filled baskets will often sell for more than the bananas themselves, as they are used to protect curry trees in farming.

Free players can also pick bananas for money, but they do not have access to teleporting jewellery or baskets. They can pay 30 coins to sailors at Port Sarim to sail to Karamja, pick 28 bananas, teleport back to the Port Sarim lodestone, and bank at the deposit box next to the Monks of Entrana just to the northeast. One trip takes about 100 seconds, for an hourly profit of 225792-1080 gp. Completing Pirate's Treasure quest will speed up banking, by being able to use the Pay-fare option to board the ship.

p.pre:
The methods described in this guide may involve considerable risks, including (but not limited to): loss of money and goods, price volatility, and low GE sales volume.
Reason: Adolescent dragons can be easily sold to other players at 200gp/bean, giving potions a value of 200K each, this means that it is more profitable to sell animals than to use this method. All other animals have a higher GP/bean value.
You can discuss this issue on the [ talk page] or [ edit] this page to improve it.

m.t: Farming bloodweed with supreme growth potion (leafy)
m.pg: Money making guide/Picking bloodweed with supreme growth potion (leafy)

inp.nt: 1,000 beans each; 400k for 2k beans (buying ado drags) = 200gp/bean or 200k/potion

m.h:
After saving up some of your beans purchase supreme growth potions (leafy). Have your Farming run gear on for maximising your yields, drink a dose of juju farming potion. Rake the herb patch if necessary, compost it, plant one seed, use the supreme growth potion (leafy) on the patch, pick the herbs. Rinse and repeat. The Goth leprechaun nearby can note your herbs.

You may only grow bloodweed at the Wilderness herb patch.

This guide does not take into consideration the time or money required to obtain beans for buying growth potions.

The profit can be further increased with the use of a dwarven harvester in Resource mode. Using patch bombs will only deplete one charge from the harvester and greatly speed up profit.

m.t: Picking cabbages
m.pg: Money making guide/Picking cabbages
m.h:
Put War's Retreat Teleport on your main skilling/non-combat action bar and have that as your primary bar. Right click on your (equipped) explorer's ring 3, cabbage-port, then start plucking in organised fashion so you can always walk two steps over to the next cabbage. Going across rows each time is advised. Once your inventory is full, teleport to War's Retreat and go to the bank chest. Hit 3 to bank-all and Esc to exit with your cursor already on your explorer's ring. Repeat.

As an alternative for free players without the War's Retreat Teleport, the Skull of Remembrance from the quest The Death of Chivalry can be used to teleport close to a bank chest.

Low-level players should beware Goblin Raids spawning on the cabbage patch, although Goblin Raiders are not aggressive.

m.t: Picking cactus spines
m.pg: Money making guide/Picking cactus spines

rq.h: 55 Farming 75 Farming (recommended)
Partial completion of The Jack of Spades
Completed Totem of the Abyss

m.h:
Cactus spines can be picked from the cactus patches in Al Kharid, Menaphos and on anachronia. A new one spawns on the cactus every 25 minutes, for up to 3 total per patch. Use the Al Kharid lodestone and walk east to the cactus patch. Pick the three spines, possibly noting them with the tool leprechaun. Repeat at the Menaphos cactus patch, using the Menaphos lodestone and walking north-west to the patch. If you have totem of the abyss on the northern location you can then use Anachronia Teleport and harvest the anachronia patch.

Completing the hard Desert Tasks is strongly recommended, as it will double the yield of cactus spines. When combined with the giant ent, you'll get an average of 9 spines per patch, up from 3 without any bonuses.

If possible, you should use a giant ent familiar, which has a 50% chance of doubling the yield of cactus spines, giving you an average of 4.5 spines instead of 3. That makes this method work well with other harvesting money makers, such as picking papayas or coconuts. The 75 minute timer also makes it coincide well with herb farming runs (which can be done every 80 minutes), although giant ents do not give a harvest boost to herbs.

m.t: Picking cadava berries
m.pg: Money making guide/Picking cadava berries
m.h:
Cadava berries are valuable as ingredients in Necromancy potions. They can be picked from cadava bushes south of Varrock. There are 3 of them with 2 berries each, or 6 in total.

Due to the long respawn time, this method requires world switching to gather berries more quickly. The gathering speed would depend on how fast world switching can be done.

After 5 worlds, you should have 28 berries. Banking is fastest with War's Retreat Teleport, then use Archaeology journal to teleport back. If you have not unlocked War's Retreat Teleport, you can bank with the journal. 25 runs are possible in 1 hour.

Cadava berries are in high demand and the bushes are not instanced, so there might be occasional competition making it take longer to gather berries.

m.t: Picking coconuts
m.pg: Money making guide/Picking coconuts

rq.h: Witchdoctor mask, or Juju teleport spiritbag
Palm trees already planted in patches

m.h:
240 Coins are needed only for the charter ship; the Karamja lodestone is no cost. Juju teleport spiritbag cost can be eliminated using the witchdoctor mask. Coconuts grow on palm trees, and they're used to make coconut milk, used in high-level Herblore. They're also used to pay farmers to look after magic trees. Once a palm tree has grown fully, it can be harvested repeatedly, with a coconut growing back every 45 minutes for a maximum of six. Harvest the coconuts and note them with the tool leprechaun at any patch if inventory becomes full.

If possible, you should use a giant ent familiar, which has a 50% chance of doubling the yield of coconuts, giving you an average of 9 coconuts per patch instead of 6. That makes this method work well with other harvesting money makers, like picking cactus spines.

m.t: Picking glowing fungus
m.pg: Money making guide/Picking glowing fungus
m.h: Picking up glowing fungus and dropping it turns it into ashes, highly valued for Necromancy as an ingredient of ghostly ink. The Underworld Grimoire is required as it automatically banks any ashes picked up and the glowing fungus is very remote. Once you have picked up a piece of the fungus, drag and drop it onto your action bar. Once it is bound to a key, you can hold that key indefinitely and any fungus you hold and further pick would automatically be dropped. Click the dropped ashes to open the loot interface, then you can use space to loot and bank all ashes on the ground at once. One inventory can be banked in about 36 seconds, or 100 loads in 1 hour (although you don't have to bank 28 ashes exactly every time). Glowing fungus regrows almost instantly.
